ordering: S0 then code review; S1 then S2 then S3 then S4. Shared query limits apply across stages, even when a primitive is called later. Per-stage and cumulative limits both apply.
subdivision_order: Breadth-first dyadic cells/strips; fixed coordinate order x then y and low coordinate first. No data-dependent threshold, model or pivot change.
spectral_method: Certified unpivoted interval LDL^T inertia; rational shift candidates midpoint, 3/8 and 5/8; all three precisions before inconclusive subdivision. Four selected-neighbor indices only. Weyl extension to closed cells.
projector_method: Riesz contour with residual-certified inverses and rigorous derivative-based quadrature remainder
frame_method: Whole-parameter interval Picard enclosures for exact Kato transport, including bottom path and vertical x strips
rank_two_polar: Positive square-root formula for 2x2 SPD Gram matrix; no signed-SVD convention
phase_method: Certified atan2 arcs and continuous lifts for alpha and repaired beta; q=(Delta beta-Delta alpha)/(2*pi)
termination: First exhausted hard cap yields INCONCLUSIVE/BUDGET; preserve certified subresults. Proven violated hypotheses refuse the affected branch. Undefined exact geometry refuses. Backend or proof-logic defects are EXECUTION_ERROR.
